The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (April 26, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: RFQ Number 6114-17-0357 Description: For the Supply and Delivery of Eight (8) Latest Model Conventional Trucks with Various Configurations. The Request for Quotation was structured to purchase only seven (7) units. Following the evaluation Fleet Services has determined the need for one (1) additional unit to be purchased which is in accordance with the terms and conditions of the RFQ. Lowest Bidders total bid price was increased to reflect eight (8) units. Recommended Bidder: Tallman Truck Centre Ltd.
